target_to_reception.feasible_next_hypothesis: Hold admitted target CDF fixed, fit a simple strongly pooled conditional catch law on earlier compatible receptions/targets, then integrate over forecast target law. Compare against unchanged strong direct receptionCDF using identical qualified population/information.
target_to_reception.mean_rule: E[R|played]=sum_t P(T=t|played)*E[R|T=t,played]. A constant catchprobability permits p*E[T], which is an expected value, not generally the reception median.
target_to_reception.median_rule: Compute actual integrated reception CDF and its lower countmedian; do not multiply a targetmedian by catchrate and call it a median.
target_to_reception.old_related: Old dynamic code propagates target point*fixedcatch_rate; preserve it as its own point heuristic, not median or integrated distribution.
